description: This file defines a test fixture class for functional testing of the Public API in the eShopOnWeb project. It customizes the web application host for tests by configuring in-memory databases for catalog and identity contexts.

classes.name: TestApiApplication
classes.description: A custom WebApplicationFactory for setting up a test environment for the Public API, configuring in-memory databases for testing purposes.

methods.name: CreateHost
methods.description: Overrides the method to create and configure the application host, setting the environment to 'Testing' and replacing database contexts with in-memory databases.
